title: Azure Hybrid
infotainment: 10.9-inch touchscreen + standard Bentley Rotating Display in Azure
adasStandard: Same base suite as the Bentayga Hybrid (adaptive cruise w/ traffic-jam assist, lane assist, blind-spot, AEB w/ pedestrian/cyclist). Azure trim adds Touring Specification standard: head-up display, night-vision, lane-departure warning. Source: https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/models/bentayga/bentayga-azure.html
adasOptional: City Specification (top-view camera, hands-free trunk, traffic assist) optional. Source: https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/models/bentayga/bentayga-azure.html
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard HD rear-view camera with dynamic trajectory guidelines. Source: https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/models/bentayga.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Top-View Camera (surround-view 360) available as part of optional City Specification. Source: https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/models/bentayga.html
subscriptionFeatures: My Bentley connected services subscription after complimentary period. No documented post-sale hardware paywall. Source: https://support.bentleymotors.com/eu/en/support-bentley.html
drmNotes: Core driving operates without internet. My Bentley connected features subscription-based after initial term. Source: https://support.bentleymotors.com/eu/en/support-bentley.html
killSwitchNotes: No dedicated impaired-driving kill-switch hardware. Driver-attention camera per VW Group platform. Source: https://www.kbb.com/car-news/nhtsas-new-kill-switch-law-approaches-key-deadline/
knownIssues: Same as Bentayga Hybrid base: anecdotal complaints around air-suspension cost and infotainment lag. Source: https://itisreliable.com/is-bentley-reliable
recalls: Not named in the 2025-2026 V8 high-pressure-fuel-pump recall. Source: https://www.thetruthaboutcars.com/cars/news-blog/recall-alert-2025-2026-bentley-continental-gtc-continental-gt-flying-spur-45131539
stateIncentives: Data unavailable: MSRP exceeds price caps for federal (expired Sep 30, 2025) and state PHEV credits. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/hybrids-evs/electric-cars-plug-in-hybrids-that-qualify-for-tax-credits-a7820795671/

title: Bentayga Hybrid
infotainment: 10.9-inch touchscreen w/ MMI-derived UI, Bentley Rotating Display optional
adasStandard: Standard ADAS suite includes adaptive cruise control with traffic-jam assist, lane assist, blind-spot monitoring with rear cross-traffic alert, traffic sign recognition, predictive efficiency assistance, and AEB with pedestrian/cyclist detection. Source: https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/models/bentayga.html
adasOptional: City Specification adds top-view 360 camera with auto-parking, rear-traffic warning, hands-free trunk, and traffic-assist. Touring Specification adds head-up display, night-vision (thermal-imaging camera), lane-departure warning. Source: https://www.kbb.com/bentley/bentayga/2025/specs/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera with dynamic trajectory guidelines; HD resolution. Source: https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/models/bentayga.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Top-View Camera (surround-view 360) is part of the optional City Specification — adds wide-angle side-view and front/rear cameras blended into a bird's-eye view. No dedicated Honda-LaneWatch-style side blind camera. Source: https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/models/bentayga.html
subscriptionFeatures: My Bentley connected services (remote functions, navigation/live-traffic OTA, concierge, secure car finder) — complimentary first term, subscription thereafter. No public list of post-sale paywalled hardware features (heated seats, etc.) as Mercedes/BMW have done. Source: https://support.bentleymotors.com/eu/en/support-bentley.html
drmNotes: Core driving operates without internet. My Bentley connected features (remote lock/unlock, find-my-car, OTA map updates) require an active subscription after initial complimentary period. OTA updates handled via VW Group MIB infotainment stack. No public record of Bentley remotely disabling post-sale features. Source: https://support.bentleymotors.com/eu/en/support-bentley.html
killSwitchNotes: No dedicated impaired-driving kill-switch hardware. Bentley follows VW Group driver-attention-monitoring camera architecture (used in newer Audi/Porsche) which could be a future substrate for compliance with the IIJA mandate; no Bentley-specific announcement. Source: https://www.kbb.com/car-news/nhtsas-new-kill-switch-law-approaches-key-deadline/
knownIssues: Industry-anecdotal complaints about air-suspension repair cost, occasional infotainment lag, and PHEV-mode transition smoothness. No widespread defect pattern documented for the V6 PHEV powertrain (shared with Porsche Cayenne E-Hybrid platform — generally well-regarded). Source: https://itisreliable.com/is-bentley-reliable
recalls: Bentayga Hybrid not named in the 2025-2026 high-pressure-fuel-pump V8 Evo recall (that recall covers V8 trims of Continental GT/GTC and 2025 Flying Spur). Source: https://www.thetruthaboutcars.com/cars/news-blog/recall-alert-2025-2026-bentley-continental-gtc-continental-gt-flying-spur-45131539
stateIncentives: Data unavailable: Bentayga Hybrid MSRP ($200k+) exceeds the $80k SUV cap for federal Inflation Reduction Act credit (expired Sep 30, 2025 regardless). State-level PHEV incentives in CA, CO, NJ, OR generally cap by MSRP or income and exclude vehicles at this price. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/hybrids-evs/electric-cars-plug-in-hybrids-that-qualify-for-tax-credits-a7820795671/
